info.name: Maihan Gems API — verified local inventory
info.description: 149 requests: one per 143 registered API route templates (including aliases), two Next.js XML sitemap routes, one additional SSE variant, and three safe negative probes. Current generated OpenAPI covers only the catalog endpoints. Mutating requests are skipped unless runMutatingRequest exactly matches the selected request name; execute one request at a time only against a disposable local database. Never bulk-run writes against shared/production data.
